threepl.nodes

Class UnlessNode

  • java.lang.Object
    • threepl.nodes.Node
      • threepl.nodes.UnlessNode
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    TDEConstants, Constant

    public final class UnlessNode
extends Node
implements Constant, TDEConstants
    Implements an exception construct on a target when, while, do while, seq, par or sync. The subnodes are -
    • the exception expression node
    • an exception block node or null
    • the subject control structure to which the exception applies
    The first two subnodes are appended by the constructor. The last subnode is appended by the associated control structure production.

        public UnlessNode(Node excep,
                  Node eblock,
                  Token t)
        Construct an exception node for a when, targ while, targ do while, seq, par or sync node. The exception block may be null
        Parameters:
        excep - is the exception expression, or is null
        eblock - is the exception block to be executed if exception value is true, or is null
        t - is a token, from which the file source location is extracted

                              java.util.ArrayList<TDEVar> startl,

                              TDEVar pri_out)
        This generates target code.
        Overrides:
        execute in class Node
        Parameters:
        esig - is an exception/restart signal, or null
        startl - is a list of start signals for target statements below this node
        finishl - is a list of finish signals for target statements below this node
        queues - returns all the queue availability signals accumulated from code below
        toplevel - is true if this is the top level in a module
        availok - is true if a previous sync makes a queue availability wait unnecessary
        checkedqueues - gives queue reads which have already been checked
        pri_in - is an optional input signal to a priority encoder
        pri_out - is an optional output signal from a priority encoder
        Returns:
        execution status value
